integrity: Analytical proof gives an explicit positive allocation, universal upper bound, and exact all-vector square certificate, including global uniqueness; exact-rational checks are supplemental. Originality comparison includes publicly inspected antecedents; one older primary paper was available only through its abstract. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-real-parameter theorem concerns normalized positive stationary masses, strictly positive individual edge prices, paths, a unit linear conductance cost, and continuous-time reversible generators only. It does not cover arbitrary graphs, zero parameters, exit-rate caps, discrete-time SLEM, or total-variation mixing time.
title: The price-metric variance law for fastest mixing on weighted birth-death paths
